long_description:
Bring the whole family for a fun, creative, and blissful yoga class! This FREE class will introduce classic yoga, meditation, breath work, and stress management in a kid-friendly style with original music, games, and imaginative stories. We have some mats on hand to borrow, but kindly bring your own if you can so that we can be sure we have enough for everybody. All ages are welcome!
